description: This file contains utility functions for converting filter clauses into adhoc filter objects within the Superset frontend codebase, including logic for matching filters and translating filter expressions to SQL.

methods.name: findMatchingFilterKey
methods.description: Finds the key in filterDataMapping that matches the given filter clause based on column, operator, and value.

methods.name: simpleFilterToAdhoc
methods.description: Converts a filter clause into an AdhocFilter object, translating to SQL if necessary, and handling extra filter options.
